args.body: Hi Eve! I just had a look at your blog at www.eve-blog.com. It's a nice, clean personal site, and I love that hiking is front and center — that's a great hobby to share with people. One suggestion: the site is pretty sparse right now, so adding a few recent blog posts (with photos from your hikes, maybe a trail map or your favorite routes) would give visitors a better sense of what your blog is actually about. A short "About Me" section and links to your socials would also help people connect with you. Keep up the good work!

Hi Dora! I just had a look at your personal website at www.dora-website.com. It's a nice, simple introduction to who you are, and it's easy to read. A couple of suggestions to make it more engaging: since the site is currently very brief, adding a short "About Me" section with a bit more detail about your background and interests would help visitors get to know you. Including some of your work, projects, or a portfolio would also give people a reason to come back. And if you share your email publicly, you may want to consider adding a contact form or a link to your other profiles so people know the best way to reach you. Nice start — keep it up!
